title: 龜山島 — real photographic reference
author: Northeast and Yilan Coast National Scenic Area official page; individual photographer not exposed
description: Seaward head cliff, summit head view and whole-island satellite cross-checked. Island elevations, western harbor and lagoon proportions are approximate; not a surveyed island model.
usage: Reference only; never used as final texture or bundled in App. Photographer/provider retains copyright; no license clearance is asserted.
method: Official source photograph of complete island profile

supplementary.author: Jimmy Chen via Google Maps

supplementary.observations: Public real seaward photo Jimmy Chen Jul 2025, steep eastern head cliff, lower saddle west and vegetated slopes; full island plan from satellite and extra summit view. Earlier Google sea-level360 reviewed too.
supplementary.limitations: Seaward head cliff, summit head view and whole-island satellite cross-checked. Island elevations, western harbor and lagoon proportions are approximate; not a surveyed island model.

supplementary.observations: Entire volcanic island outline: low western turtle tail and lagoon, high central wooded body, projecting southeastern head and pale-blue water by the head.
supplementary.limitations: Satellite is a plan reference; acquisition date not displayed, elevations and obscured geometry unmeasured.

supplementary.observations: Real summit-looking-down photo joylog weekend, capture Oct 2025 (uploaded Nov 2025). Green high eastern head with sheer cliffs and ocean beyond. Additional evidence, not ground-level or complete-island profile.
supplementary.limitations: Seaward head cliff, summit head view and whole-island satellite cross-checked. Island elevations, western harbor and lagoon proportions are approximate; not a surveyed island model.
